## Research brief: refresh the canonical timestamp and SSE duration article

- Existing canonical /blog/what-agentsight-trace-timestamps-and-sse-durations-really-mean/ (verify actual slug before editing; public Blog title is “What AgentSight trace timestamps and SSE durations really mean”) owns the reader's time-unit and stream-duration decision. Do not create a duplicate. The HTTP correlation, compressed HTTP, and trace-loss articles own different adjacent decisions and should be linked rather than rewritten wholesale. Current sitemap and Blog inventory checked; exact canonical path must be verified before implementation.
- Primary source [time.rs](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/bf7d913a74b9c3b187de60a56bbdb793b6873d22/agentsight-capture/src/time.rs): sample CLOCK_MONOTONIC before/after CLOCK_REALTIME on each conversion, compute midpoint offset, normalize to integer epoch milliseconds; fallback retains whole-second boot-time offset. Source fixture maps 1,234,567,890 ns plus offset 1,700,000,000,123,456,789 ns to 1,700,000,001,358 ms. Per-call sampling addresses suspend offset drift for current observations, not a guaranteed historical timestamp correction for delayed pre-suspend events. Source tests assert a 50 ms tolerance, not measured capture accuracy.
- [SSE aggregation design](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/bf7d913a74b9c3b187de60a56bbdb793b6873d22/ext/analysis/docs/sse-aggregation.md), [implementation](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/bf7d913a74b9c3b187de60a56bbdb793b6873d22/ext/analysis/src/analyzers/sse_stream.rs), [regressions](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/bf7d913a74b9c3b187de60a56bbdb793b6873d22/ext/analysis/src/analyzers/sse_stream_tests.rs): response aggregate grouped by HTTP exchange, not TLS fragment/provider ID; HTTP termination rather than provider finish marker; preserves late usage; duration in ns derived from ms; partial on interruption; 4 MiB per aggregate/64 MiB shared input retention/100,000 records. Those are retained input bounds, not process RSS. Compressed SSE remains whole-body path. Tests inspected, not executed.
- Candidate unique information gain: old/new clock mapping and duration units, what completion timestamp represents, late usage fixture and incomplete aggregate semantics. Acceptance: single canonical TechArticle with versioned old/new source boundaries, corrected arithmetic and test citations, unchanged unrelated routes, Blog and sitemap lastmod; exact-source deployment and public verification.
